CorrectedSystemErrorWithDumpFileDetected.Description: This message indicates a node corrected error was detected on a given processing element and all available diagnostic data was encapsulated as CPER-formatted base64-encoded text in the 'DiagnosticData' field that is attached to the Event or LogEntry.
CorrectedSystemErrorWithDumpFileDetected.Message: A corrected error was detected and a crashdump (CPER) file was created. For more details please see associated 'DiagnosticData'.
CorrectedSystemErrorWithDumpFileDetected.Resolution: Decode, then analyze the provided crashdump file to determine a root cause
